bodies.name: Verdance
bodies.class: garden world whose climate machinery runs hot
bodies.notes: A garden world whose Absent climate machinery runs hot. Its forests stand two hundred meters tall, its growing season never ends, and its predators are big enough to kill a frame. Two of the three attempts to settle it have been abandoned, the first in 5025u after the planet's predators killed forty colonists. The Verdance Colonial Company, backed by Corvel, is preparing a third.
